diminish the value: Leaving the old painting in a damp basement for years will diminish the value of this rare artwork.
把這幅古畫放在潮濕的地下室多年，會貶低這件珍貴藝術品的價值。
diminishing returns: After about six hours of study, you hit the law of diminishing returns, so extra hours help very little.
讀書大約六小時後，你就會碰到報酬遞減法則，所以多讀的時間幫助很小。
his influence diminished: After he left the company, his influence diminished quickly, and few people asked for his opinion anymore.
他離開公司後，影響力迅速減弱，很少人再徵詢他的意見。
diminish one's achievements: Losing the final game does not diminish your achievements this season; you still played wonderfully.
輸掉決賽並不會貶低你這一季的成就；你仍然表現得很出色。
dip into savings: When her car broke down, Lisa had to dip into her savings to pay for the expensive repairs.
莉莎的車拋錨時，她不得不動用存款來支付昂貴的修理費。
dip into a book: I like to dip into a book of short poems before bed instead of reading it from cover to cover.
我喜歡在睡前翻閱一本短詩集，而不是從頭讀到尾。
dip one's toe in: Before investing a lot of money, you could dip your toe in the stock market with a small amount first.
在投入大筆資金之前，你可以先用少量的錢淺嘗股市。
be discharged from hospital: After two weeks of treatment, my grandfather was finally discharged from hospital and came home.
經過兩週的治療，我爺爺終於出院回家了。
discharge a duty: As a police officer, he always tries to discharge his duty with honesty and courage, even in danger.
身為警察，他總是努力以誠實和勇氣履行職責，即使身處危險也一樣。
discharge waste: The factory was fined for illegally discharging waste into the river near the village.
那間工廠因非法將廢棄物排放到村莊附近的河裡而被罰款。
discharge a patient: Doctors will not discharge a patient until they are sure he can take care of himself at home.
醫生要確定病患能在家照顧自己，才會讓病患出院。
discipline a child: Parents should discipline a child calmly instead of shouting at him whenever he breaks a rule.
父母應該冷靜地管教小孩，而不是在他每次違反規定時就對他大吼。
discipline oneself: To finish the marathon, you must discipline yourself to run every morning, even on cold rainy days.
要跑完馬拉松，你必須自律，每天早上跑步，即使在寒冷的雨天也一樣。
disciplined training: Years of disciplined training helped the young pianist play the difficult piece without a single mistake.
多年紀律嚴明的訓練幫助這位年輕鋼琴家毫無失誤地彈完這首困難的曲子。
disclose information: The bank promised never to disclose information about its customers to anyone without their permission.
銀行承諾未經客戶許可，絕不向任何人揭露有關客戶的資訊。
disclose one's identity: The writer chose not to disclose her identity, so readers only knew her by a strange pen name.
這位作家選擇不透露她的身分，所以讀者只知道她奇怪的筆名。
disclose the terms: Neither company would disclose the terms of the deal to reporters, so the price remains a secret.
兩家公司都不願向記者公開這筆交易的條款，所以價格至今仍是個祕密。
discount the possibility: The police cannot discount the possibility that the fire was started on purpose by someone in the building.
警方無法排除這場火是大樓裡某人故意縱火的可能性。
discount a theory: Most scientists discount the theory that the pyramids were built by aliens, since there is no evidence for it.
大多數科學家不採信金字塔是外星人建造的理論，因為沒有任何證據。
discount the price: The store will discount the price of all winter jackets by thirty percent during next week's sale.
這家店在下週特賣期間將把所有冬季外套的價格打折，降價百分之三十。
discount one's claims: The judge decided to discount his claims because none of the witnesses could support his story.
法官決定對他的說法不予理會，因為沒有任何證人能支持他的說詞。
discourage smoking: The government raised cigarette taxes again this year to discourage smoking among young people.
政府今年再次調高菸稅，以勸阻年輕人吸菸。
be discouraged by failure: Try not to be discouraged by failure, because losing heart too soon may stop you from reaching your goals.
盡量不要因失敗而氣餒，因為太早灰心可能會讓你無法達成目標。
discourage someone from: My parents tried to discourage me from riding a motorcycle because they thought it was too dangerous.
我父母試圖勸我別騎機車，因為他們覺得那太危險了。
discriminate against women: It is illegal for companies to discriminate against women by paying them less than men for the same job.
公司以同樣工作給女性比男性低的薪水來歧視女性，是違法的。
discriminate between right and wrong: Young children cannot always discriminate between right and wrong, so adults need to guide them patiently.
小孩不一定能分辨是非，所以大人需要耐心地引導他們。
discriminate on the basis of race: No employer is allowed to discriminate on the basis of race; everyone deserves the same chance to get a job.
任何雇主都不得因種族而歧視；每個人都應該有相同的求職機會。
disguise one's voice: The kidnapper used a machine to disguise his voice so that the police could not recognize him.
綁匪用機器偽裝聲音，讓警方認不出他。
disguise the truth: He told a funny story to disguise the truth that he had forgotten to do his homework again.
他講了一個好笑的故事，來掩飾他又忘了寫作業的真相。
disguise oneself as: To sneak into the party, the reporter decided to disguise himself as a waiter carrying drinks.
為了混進派對，那名記者決定喬裝成端飲料的服務生。
